svg.title: All features — Smart Warehouse Planner
svg.desc: Concept 09 Exposure Sheets: the features menu as a ruled exposure-record card (Ctrl K), every feature a row with step, name, what it holds and shortcut; stage-2 rows struck as later.
svg.text: Spring re-slot 2026 · data as of 2026-09-30 · round 1 · the flow runs top to bottom

Period 12 months · class limits · pick-group minimum 5
